** Minor** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Add a timeout to the `gh` subprocess call.** `subprocess.run` has no `timeout`. If `gh` stalls on a network call, `poll` never reaches its own `--timeout` check. The CLI then hangs, which defeats the bounded `--wait` behavior in `SKILL.md`. Pass a `timeout` and convert `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` to `GhError`. Then `poll` can count it as a transient failure and retry.
🛠️ Proposed fix
```diff --- "a/plugins/productivity/scripts/coderabbit_gate.py" +++ "b/plugins/productivity/scripts/coderabbit_gate.py" @@ -213,9 +213,13 @@ if gh is None: msg = "gh が見つからない" raise GhError(msg) - result = subprocess.run( # ruff: ignore[subprocess-without-shell-equals-true] - gh は which で解決した絶対パス、引数はリストで渡す - [gh, *args], check=False, capture_output=True, text=True, env=gh_env(os.environ) - ) + try: + result = subprocess.run( # ruff: ignore[subprocess-without-shell-equals-true] - gh は which で解決した絶対パス、引数はリストで渡す + [gh, *args], check=False, capture_output=True, text=True, env=gh_env(os.environ), timeout=GH_TIMEOUT + ) + except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error: + msg = f"gh {' '.join(args[:2])} が {GH_TIMEOUT} 秒で終わらなかった" + raise GhError(msg) from error if result.returncode != 0: msg = f"gh {' '.join(args[:2])} が失敗した: {result.stderr.strip()[:500]}" raise GhError(msg) ``` Also add `GH_TIMEOUT = 60` next to `MAX_GH_FAILURES`.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Limit the publication check to reviews on the current head.** `incomplete_publications` reads every CodeRabbit status review on the PR, including reviews of older commits. If one old publication never received all its batches, `batches != set(range(1, total + 1))` stays true forever. In `evaluate_coderabbit`, the `elif incomplete` branch runs before `elif evidence`. The head then stays `publishing` and the verdict stays `WAITING` until `--timeout`. A new push does not clear this state. Filter the reviews by `commit.oid == snapshot.head` before you call `incomplete_publications`.
🛠️ Proposed fix
```diff - incomplete = incomplete_publications(reviews) + incomplete = incomplete_publications([r for r in reviews if text(dig(r, "commit", "oid")) == snapshot.head]) ```

** Minor** · **Security & Privacy** · **Quick win** **Count only CodeRabbit-authored thread comments as inline ids.** `inline_ids` takes `cr-comment` ids from the first comment of every thread. It does not check the author. On a public repo, any user can post a diff comment that contains a body-finding id. The id then enters `inline_ids`, and `body_findings_of` skips that finding. If the PR author resolves that spam thread, the finding is dropped silently. The `is_coderabbit` and `is_trusted` checks cover identity everywhere else in this file. Apply the same check here.
🛠️ Proposed fix
```diff - for node in as_list(dig(item, "first", "nodes")): - inline_ids.update(groups(FINDING_RE, text(as_dict(node).get("body")))) + for node in as_list(dig(item, "first", "nodes")): + if is_coderabbit(node): + inline_ids.update(groups(FINDING_RE, text(as_dict(node).get("body")))) ```
